name: Conspiracy Craze!
author: OmarSaid0
description:
A concept game during GGJ 2021, done in 48HRS, made by a team.
Credits:
Game Design: DieP

Art Designers: MatchaGoga, Naru Lin, JED, graes_b4

Programmer: G3GaByte

Sound Designer: humanpyramids

Description:

Four Conspiracy theorists have to find the truth, but one of them is a reptilian in disguise! Can the three humans find the real conspiracy before the reptilian reaches his goal? This is a investigative co-op game. One of the players is a reptilian that has to reach his goal without being exposed and the other players have to look for clues throughout different historical ages, while they lose everything: cards, identities and trust between each other.
